title: 007 门神帖008 超凡物质与天坑
content_zh:
十分钟后。
许临东顺利在物资处提前支取了两瓶五级超凡药剂和一万六的奖金。
五级超凡药剂封装在透明的玻璃管中，液体颜色跟可乐差不多，还泛着气泡。
仅仅是握在手中，便能感受到一股温润的能量气泡正在碰撞瓶壁。
“这五级超凡药剂对你这种序列十的超凡者而言，只能说算是最低级的补剂，对还没晋升序列的人倒是用处更大。”
“有钱你还是购买四级超凡药剂吧，那玩意儿劲儿大，对你有用！”
物资处主任推了推鼻梁上的厚镜片，老态龙钟地靠在椅背上，声音带着几分懒散道：“转正后，你的身份权限已经更新。
现在你已经可以登录神异司内部网络，查阅大部分归档的神异事件资料、异物图鉴和一些非绝密的行动记录了。
多看看，马上你还有转正后的清扫场域任务，早作准备。”
“谢谢胡主任提醒。”
许临东点头致谢。
神异司里卧虎藏龙。
这些各部门的老前辈，说不准就是中序列的强者，必须给予足够的尊敬。
他将药剂和现金收好，目光扫过物资处内部。
一排排宛如银行保险柜的金属货架整齐排列在那里，每一个格位都标注着编号。
俨然是个小型宝库，陈列着各种神异物资。
其中大多是功能各异、相对安全可控的“神异物”
或“灵异物”
与那些混乱危险的“邪异物”
不同，只需付出一定代价或满足特定条件便可使用。

仅仅是站在十米开外，许临东便能感受到脖颈衣物下，通天塔吊坠正传来微微的震颤。
仿佛对货架上的某些物品产生了兴趣，想要统统关押。
他按捺躁动，道：“胡主任，我想看看晋升天道序列九所需的超凡物质材料。”
虽说他距离晋升序列九【门神】还早。
但提前了解、早做准备，总没有坏处。
“晋升天道序列九的材料？我看看……”
老头在身前的电脑上操作了几下，随后从手边厚厚一沓档案册里抽出一本，翻到某一页，推了出来。
许临东的目光立刻被吸引。
那一页上贴着一张照片，内容是一份泛黄的古旧卷轴。
旁边的标注清晰写道：【天道序列九·门神晋升超凡物·门神帖（秦琼像）‘拓印’】。
下方的说明简略提及，此帖传承古老，绘有门神秦琼神韵，得自江城古镇宗祠古宅天坑，兑换需一级执行官权限及八十万夏国币，或八千功勋值。
许临东看着那门神帖，想到自己才三级执行官的身份和远不足以兑换的三百多功勋，不由无奈。
“这超凡物质还真是贵啊！
不过，似乎可以去超凡天坑内完成清扫任务时获取？”
content_en:
Ten minutes later.
Xu Lindong successfully withdrew two bottles of fifth-level extraordinary potions and a bonus of 16,000 from the supplies department in advance.
The fifth-level extraordinary potion is encapsulated in a transparent glass tube. The liquid is about the same color as cola and is filled with bubbles.
Just by holding it in your hand, you can feel a warm energy bubble colliding with the bottle wall.
"This level five extraordinary potion can only be regarded as the lowest level supplement for a level ten extraordinary like you. It is more useful for people who have not yet advanced to the level."
"If you have money, you'd better buy a fourth-level extraordinary potion. That thing is very powerful and will be useful to you!"
The director of the Materials Department pushed up the thick lenses on the bridge of his nose, leaned on the back of his chair with an old look, and said in a lazy voice: "After becoming a full-time employee, your identity and permissions have been updated.
Now you can log in to the internal network of the Department of Mysteries and view most of the archived supernatural event information, foreign object illustrations, and some non-top-secret action records.
Read more. You will soon have the task of cleaning up the area after becoming a full-time employee, so prepare early. "
"Thank you, Director Hu, for reminding me."
Xu Lindong nodded in thanks.
Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon in the Miracle Division.
These seniors in various departments may be mid-level experts, and they must be given enough respect.
He put away the medicine and cash and glanced inside the supplies department.
Rows of metal shelves like bank safes are neatly arranged there, and each slot is marked with a number.
It is like a small treasure house, displaying various magical materials.
Most of them are "miraculous objects" with different functions, relatively safe and controllable
or "supernatural"
and those chaotic and dangerous “evil foreign objects”
Different, you only need to pay a certain price or meet certain conditions to use it.
Just standing ten meters away, Xu Lindong could feel the slight tremor coming from the Babel pendant under the clothes on his neck.
It seems that he has become interested in certain items on the shelves and wants to lock them all away.
He suppressed his restlessness and said: "Director Hu, I want to see the extraordinary material materials needed to advance to the ninth sequence of Heavenly Dao."
Although it is still early for him to be promoted to Sequence Nine [Door God].
But it never hurts to know and prepare in advance.
"Materials for promotion to Tiandao Sequence Nine? Let me see..."
The old man operated a few times on the computer in front of him, then took out a book from the thick stack of files at hand, turned to a certain page, and pushed it out.
Xu Lindong's eyes were immediately attracted.
There was a photo on that page, and the content was a yellowed ancient scroll.
The mark next to it clearly reads: [Tiandao Sequence Nine· Door God’s Promotion to Extraordinary Object· Door God’s Tie (Qin Qiong’s Statue) ‘Rubbing’].
The description below briefly mentions that this post has an ancient heritage and is painted with the charm of the door god Qin Qiong. It was obtained from the tiankeng of the ancient house of the ancestral hall in the ancient town of Jiangcheng. The exchange requires the authority of a first-level executive officer and 800,000 Xia national coins, or 8,000 merit points.
Xu Lindong looked at the magic post and couldn't help but think of his status as a third-level executive officer and the more than 300 meritorious deeds that were far from enough to exchange for it.
“This extraordinary material is really expensive!
However, it seems that you can get it when you complete the cleaning mission in the extraordinary sinkhole? "
